notes.title: Sylphy coming soon to Cosplay Crisis - Succubus Invasion
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071210/Cosplay_Crisis__Succubus_Invasion]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071210/Cosplay_Crisis__Succubus_Invasion[/url]

Cosplay Crisis launches any day now. With Sylphy among the main cast. 
Originally she was intended as a custom character example without much content, but I ended up including her with the other girls in the cgs so she has just as many lewds as the everyone else.

Cosplay Crisis is a roguelite bullet heaven about a Succubus that wants to win a cosplay contest at a convention, who charms the male attendees to try and destroy her competition. The girls have to take up arms to defend their outfits or be sent home blushing.

The game also features someone cosplaying Mio, of Mommy Milkers Miko.

notes.title: Sylphy update
notes.notes:
This version fixes the lag bug with the lockpicking. It was hard to reproduce but it finally happened to me when i tried to replace the minigame graphics with a live2d model.

It turned out it was the waiting for the player to press keys that was causing the lag, not the tumbler images loading in quick succession.

The live2d model was also a bust since you could see it resetting even with what should have been instant.

The fix also made it so the flicker doesnt happen on first loop as well.

notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
Someone notified me that the achievements were visible even though i hadn't flagged the game as having that feature.

I couldn't make them work before release because that's just how the plugin works.
